SELECT
  AVG(avg_unit_price) AS average_of_group_average_unit_prices,
  AVG(product_count) AS average_of_group_counts,
  AVG(count_difference) AS average_count_difference
FROM (
  SELECT
    color_group.avg_unit_price,
    color_group.product_count,
    color_group.product_count - count_average.avg_count AS count_difference
  FROM (
    SELECT product_color, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM Products
    GROUP BY product_color
  ) AS color_group
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(product_count) AS avg_count
    FROM (
      SELECT product_color, COUNT(*) AS product_count
      FROM Products
      GROUP BY product_color
    )
  ) AS count_average
  WHERE color_group.product_count > count_average.avg_count
)
